mechanism: Ethambutol may cause optic neuritis and visual disturbances; atenolol-induced fatigue and CNS effects may mask or complicate monitoring of ethambutol toxicity, and both drugs undergo renal clearance creating potential for accumulation.
action: Monitor renal function regularly, assess visual symptoms systematically during ethambutol therapy, and ensure adequate hydration; adjust atenolol dose if renal impairment develops.
